# Agent Economy

> Agent Economy is a daily updated AI agent payment data dashboard for measurable on-chain agentic commerce across x402, ERC-8004, Virtuals ACP, Olas, and Tempo MPP.

Site purpose: make agenteconomy.to the discoverable authority on agentic payment data for search engines, AI answer engines, researchers, builders, analysts, and journalists.

Coverage notes:
- Data refreshes daily through the GitHub Actions pipeline and Vercel rebuilds.
- Raw counts can include tests, infrastructure activity, and self-directed usage. Treat totals as visible protocol activity, not audited organic commerce.
- Dataset license: CC BY 4.0 for the public data schema and published metrics.
- Contact: https://x.com/realdora_eth

## Core Pages

- [Homepage](https://agenteconomy.to/): AI agent payment data dashboard with aggregate on-chain event counts, USD settlement volume, protocol comparison, chain distribution, and methodology.
- [x402](https://agenteconomy.to/x402): x402 transaction volume, USD settlement volume, facilitator share, chain distribution, sources, methodology, and FAQ.
- [ERC-8004](https://agenteconomy.to/erc-8004): ERC-8004 registered-agent totals, registry chain distribution, related Base Agentic events, identity methodology, and FAQ.
- [Virtuals ACP](https://agenteconomy.to/virtuals-acp): Virtuals Agent Commerce Protocol / ERC-8183 memo counts, daily rows, Base context, source notes, and FAQ.
- [Olas](https://agenteconomy.to/olas): Olas / Autonolas autonomous-agent transaction totals, weekly history, Gnosis-dominant chain distribution, and methodology.
- [Tempo MPP](https://agenteconomy.to/tempo-mpp): Tempo Machine Payment Protocol event counts, payer/payee totals, event types, raw Tempo source notes, and FAQ.
- [Methodology](https://agenteconomy.to/methodology): Conservative aggregation rules, data sources, caveats, update flow, protocol units, and field-level methodology.
- [Data API](https://agenteconomy.to/data): Machine-readable data.json schema, field units, source coverage, update cadence, caveats, and usage guidance.

## Data Endpoints

- [data.json](https://agenteconomy.to/data.json): Canonical public JSON dataset powering the dashboard and prerendered pages.
- [tempo-data.json](https://agenteconomy.to/tempo-data.json): Tempo MPP RPC-indexed source summary that is merged into data.json.

## Discovery

- [Sitemap](https://agenteconomy.to/sitemap.xml): Indexable route list with daily lastmod values generated at build time.
- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/realdora/agenteconomy): Source code, issue tracker, and data-source contribution path.

## Optional

- [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/): License used for the public data schema and published dashboard metrics.
